title: Challenge 4 Quiz - AI for Everyday Productivity

questions.question: What is one of the main benefits of using AI for writing and communication?
options: It helps improve writing quality and saves time.
It guarantees every document is error-free.
It removes the need for proofreading.

questions.question: How can AI support students and lifelong learners?
options: By taking examinations on their behalf.
By acting as a personal tutor that explains concepts and creates practice questions.
By preventing learners from making mistakes.

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of AI helping with organization and time management?
options: Making personal decisions without your approval.

questions.question: How does AI improve business productivity?
options: By supporting customer service, communication and project management.
By eliminating the need for employees.
By making business decisions without human involvement.

questions.question: What is an AI workflow?
options: A structured process where AI assists with different steps of completing a task.

questions.question: Why is it important to review AI-generated work before publishing it?
options: Because AI may produce inaccurate, incomplete or unclear information.

questions.question: What is the recommended way to use multiple AI tools?
options: Use each tool for the task it performs best.
Only use one AI tool for every situation.

questions.question: Which habit leads to better long-term productivity?
options: Depending on AI for every decision.

questions.question: Which statement about AI is TRUE?
options: AI should support human decision-making rather than replace it.
AI should make all important decisions automatically.
AI eliminates the need for critical thinking.

questions.question: What is one of the most important skills for using AI effectively every day?
options: Building practical workflows and using AI responsibly.
